title: Detailed toothbrush
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Background: none -->
  <!-- Handle: bright cyan with lighter highlight stripe -->
  <rect x='42' y='30' width='16' height='62' rx='6' fill='#00d4ff'/>
  <rect x='46' y='32' width='4' height='56' rx='2' fill='#a8f4ff'/>
  <!-- Grip ridges: contrasting darker cyan -->
  <rect x='42' y='60' width='16' height='3' fill='#0099cc'/>
  <rect x='42' y='67' width='16' height='3' fill='#0099cc'/>
  <rect x='42' y='74' width='16' height='3' fill='#0099cc'/>
  <rect x='42' y='81' width='16' height='3' fill='#0099cc'/>
  <!-- Neck: lime green -->
  <rect x='44' y='20' width='12' height='14' rx='3' fill='#7dff3d'/>
  <!-- Brush head: bright yellow, rounded -->
  <rect x='38' y='6' width='24' height='20' rx='9' fill='#ffe100'/>
  <rect x='38' y='20' width='24' height='4' fill='#f0b800'/>
  <!-- Bristle rows: white and light pink alternating -->
  <!-- Row 1 -->
  <rect x='41' y='3' width='3' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='46' y='3' width='3' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#ffaacc'/>
  <rect x='51' y='3' width='3' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='56' y='3' width='3' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#ffaacc'/>
  <!-- Row 2 (slightly lower) -->
  <rect x='41' y='8' width='3' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#ffaacc'/>
  <rect x='46' y='8' width='3' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='51' y='8' width='3' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#ffaacc'/>
  <rect x='56' y='8' width='3' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Row 3 -->
  <rect x='41' y='13' width='3' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='46' y='13' width='3' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#ffaacc'/>
  <rect x='51' y='13' width='3' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='56' y='13' width='3' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#ffaacc'/>
  <!-- Small sparkle near brush for cuteness -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='14' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='38' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
